description_expanded: AboutGrayt Blue Mountain | Luxury 30A Vacation Rental Between Grayton Beach and Blue Mountain Beach 4 Bedrooms | 4.5 Bathrooms | Sleeps 12 | Gated Community | Near Beach | Fenced Yard | Community Pool | Pickleball and Tennis Courts Why Guests Love Grayt Blue Mountain • Recently renovated with new paint, flooring, furniture, lighting, and decor! • Large community pool plus pickleball and tennis courts • Luxury 30A vacation rental located between Grayton Beach and Blue Mountain Beach • Gated community offering privacy, security, and resort-style amenities • Four spacious bedrooms with four and a half bathrooms, all bedrooms featuring private ensuite baths • Sleeps up to 12 guests, ideal for families, multi-generational trips, and group getaways • Enjoy the large beach at Blue Mountain Beach access and Grayton Beach • Fully fenced backyard with outdoor grill and patio seating • Screened-in back porch perfect for relaxing evenings • Multiple porches and balconies for morning coffee and sunset cocktails • Fully stocked kitchen with high-end appliances and entertaining essentials • Family-friendly amenities including toys, books, games, bicycles, Pack and Play, and highchair • Close to Blue Mountain Creamery, Red Fish Taco, AJ’s Grayton Beach, and Grayton Corners • Near bike paths, boutique shopping, art galleries, and top 30A dining A Luxury 30A Vacation Home in Blue Mountain Beach Welcome to Grayt Blue Mountain, a beautifully designed luxury vacation rental on Scenic Highway 30A, perfectly positioned between the charm of Grayton Beach and the relaxed vibe of Blue Mountain Beach. Located inside a desirable gated community with resort-style amenities, this four-bedroom retreat offers the perfect balance of upscale comfort, family-friendly design, and easy access to the Emerald Coast’s famous sugar-white sand beaches. Whether you are planning a beach vacation with kids, a multi-family getaway, or a relaxing coastal escape with friends, Grayt Blue Mountain provides the space, layout, and location travelers search for when booking a 30A vacation rental. First Floor – Open Concept Living and Outdoor Connection The first floor welcomes guests into a bright, open-concept living space designed for gathering and connection. Large windows fill the home with natural light, while coastal finishes create a relaxed yet refined atmosphere. The living area flows seamlessly into the fully stocked gourmet kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances, generous counter space, and everything needed to prepare meals at home or entertain with ease. A first-floor king bedroom with private ensuite bathroom is ideal for guests seeking convenience without stairs. French doors lead to the screened-in back porch, offering a peaceful spot to unwind after a day at the beach. Beyond the porch, the fenced backyard provides space for outdoor dining, grilling, and relaxing under the Florida sky. Second Floor – Private Suites and Family-Friendly Bunk Room Upstairs, three additional bedrooms provide privacy and comfort for every guest. • King Suite with private ensuite bathroom and balcony • Queen Suite with private ensuite bathroom and balcony • Spacious bunk room designed for kids and teens, featuring: – One twin-over-full bunk bed with trundle – One full-over-full bunk bed – Private ensuite bathroom Each bedroom includes comfortable bedding, smart TVs, and thoughtful details that make guests feel right at home. Resort-Style Community Amenities Guests at Grayt Blue Mountain enjoy access to exceptional community amenities, including: • Large community swimming pool with lounge seating • Pickleball courts and tennis courts • Quiet, walkable streets ideal for biking and morning strolls This gated neighborhood offers a peaceful setting while remaining close to everything 30A has to offer. Prime 30A Location Near Beaches, Dining, and Entertainment Grayt Blue Mountain is perfectly located for exploring the best of Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, and Scenic Highway 30A. Nearby favorites include: • Blue Mountain Beach access with soft sand and clear Gulf waters • Blue Mountain Creamery for ice cream and coffee • Red Fish Taco for casual coastal dining • AJ’s Grayton Beach for live music and entertainment • Grayton Corners for boutique shopping and local eateries Bike paths, beach access points, art galleries, and outdoor adventures are all just minutes away. Perfect for Families, Groups, and Extended Stays With four ensuite bedrooms, a flexible bunk room, family-friendly amenities, and both indoor and outdoor living spaces, Grayt Blue Mountain is designed for effortless vacations. Guests love the combination of space, privacy, resort amenities, and proximity to the beach — without sacrificing comfort or style. Book Your Blue Mountain Beach and Grayton Beach Escape If you are searching for a luxury 30A vacation rental, a Blue Mountain Beach vacation home, or a family-friendly rental near Grayton Beach, Grayt Blue Mountain checks every box. Book your stay today and experience elevated coastal living in one of 30A’s most desirable locations.
